tweet_pool.author: altryne
tweet_pool.text: MidJourney just announced... a full body ultrasound! "As powerful as MRI and as casual as a trip to the spa". They are calling it "the @midjourney scanner". The device uses 8,960 individual transducers arranged in a ring around your body, resolves motion at the picometer range, and processes 17 gigabytes of data per second. Midjourney claims fewer than 12 of these machines could perform more full-body scans than every MRI machine on Earth combined, deployed in a "Midjourney SPA".
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete surprising hardware product announcement from Midjourney with detailed specs; high engagement, distinct.

tweet_pool.selection_reason: Official OpenAI report of a GPT-5.4 medicinal chemistry result validated experimentally; concrete distinct science story.

tweet_pool.author: chamath
tweet_pool.text:
It may be overfit so it’s a bit early to declare any sort of victory but it is really good to see open-weight models catch up to the closed source labs so quickly after their latest releases.

With recursive RL, the delta in time between a closed source model and an equivalent open-weight one keeps shrinking.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Practitioner/investor analysis on open-weight models closing the gap with closed labs via recursive RL; distinct viewpoint.

tweet_pool.author: johnschulman2
tweet_pool.text: PPO had a second wave in the LLM era for reasons unanticipated by the original paper - the importance-ratio objective fixes biases from numeric error, async training, and forward pass noise; the clipping objective affects entropy through a mechanism that we didn't know about at the time.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Strong technical observation from John Schulman on why PPO works in the LLM era; high-signal practitioner analysis.

tweet_pool.author: sairahul1
tweet_pool.text: Andrej Karpathy: "90% of Claude's mistakes come from missing context, not a weak model." 41% mistake rate without a CLAUDE.md, 11% with a 4-rule baseline, 3% with a 12-rule version. Lists the 12 rules senior engineers settled on for agentic coding.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete practitioner data on context engineering reducing agent mistake rates; useful technical analysis.
